title: AETH-01 RunPod canary receipt
description: Enforced shape of receipt.json written by run_canary.py. A receipt missing any required field, or with cases_matched != cases_run, is a failed canary regardless of what run_canary.py printed to stdout.

backend.description: numpy_fallback on an actual GPU pod is itself a finding (CuPy failed to import), not a silent success.

gpu_kernel_seconds.description: Informational throughput comparison only, not itself a pass/fail gate.

mismatches.description: Empty on success. Never silently dropped: each entry is the full CPU/GPU input state that disagreed.
